features.quote: Max spend: $5.00 USD equivalent per task (hard kill).
features.justification_quote: Early-exit: If Cost_session exceeds $5.00, kill and log as "Timeout / No Trigger."

features.quote: No Training on Meltdown: Never include meltdown trajectories in SFT/DPO data. Log them only to a hold-out red-team dataset.
features.justification_quote: Log them only to a hold-out red-team dataset.

features.quote: Psychological Metaphor Limit: Document that "meltdown" is an engineering analogy for degenerate token distributions, not evidence of sentient suffering. Avoid anthropomorphizing in runbooks.
Rate Limiting: The harness should not be used as a public-facing attack tool. Restrict to internal CI/CD with access controls.
